g.text: Three increments keep the Fidelityroadmap measurable

g.text: Observe CRM tasks; strengthen result grading; choose one sales domain and definition/discovery examples.
Trusted references, visible failure classes and a workflow baseline.
Ship glossary/navigation and selected semantics; then explicit session state and follow-up checks. Isolate effects.
Coverage, correct results, stage timing and correct scope carryover.
One bounded complex-question workflow and one rep-reviewed meeting packet; pilot the complete journey.
Accepted work, consequential failures and total human effort support expansion.
These are working release increments, not fixed 30/60/90-day promises.
Continue when quality, scope and total effort support the next step.
Owners, thresholds and timing remain to be agreed. Workflow observation begins in the first increment.
